title: Great!
body: It’s user friendly and helps me see how much progress I’m making clearly. That’s motivation enough for me 👍🏻

title: Excellent App!!!!
body:
I love Habitify. With this app on both my iPhone and Apple Watch, I've been able to create and stick to a daily routine/process. It had made life so much easier. 

Thank you Habitify.
author: Nivash
